parameterMigrations.note: Google deprecates the May 2026 Antigravity agent and recommends antigravity-preview-09-2026. Remote-sandbox consumers that read only final model output can change the agent ID directly; local tool/function-call consumers must also migrate the built-in tool schemas.

notes: Google released antigravity-preview-05-2026 on 2026-05-19 in public preview.
Google deprecated this agent on 2026-09-17 and lists 2026-10-05 as its shutdown date.
The September replacement changes local built-in file tools from snake_case parameters/full-file writes to PascalCase parameters and line-range editing.
Historical capability fields remain conservative where Google did not provide old-agent-specific declarations in the checked migration documentation.
